title: Race Condition Audit: find all concurrent-access bugs — FishBot aiogram
description:
## Task: Race Condition Audit — FishBot

### Context
FishBot — Python 3.12, aiogram 3.x, SQLAlchemy 2.x async, PostgreSQL.
Async bot = multiple users can trigger same handler simultaneously.

### Known race conditions already fixed
- `activate_subscription`: SELECT FOR UPDATE + IntegrityError catch
- `get_or_create_user`: IntegrityError on concurrent /start
- `use_promo`: SELECT FOR UPDATE

### Where to look for NEW race conditions
```python
# Pattern 1: check-then-act without lock
count = await session.execute(select(func.count(...)).where(...))
if count < limit:         # <-- another request can slip in here
    session.add(new_item) # <-- both get added

# Pattern 2: read-modify-write without transaction
user = await get_user(...)
user.settings.modules["counter"] += 1  # <-- concurrent reads see same value
await session.commit()

# Pattern 3: group operations
# group_fishing.py: create group, add member — two separate commits?
```

### Files to check
- `bot/handlers/group_fishing.py` — create group, join, invite
- `bot/handlers/catch.py` — monthly catch limit check
- `bot/handlers/session.py` — open/close session
- `bot/services/payments.py` — activate_subscription (already fixed, verify)
- `bot/db.py` — any other check-then-act patterns

### Deliverable
List of race conditions found:
```
| File:Line | Pattern | Scenario | Severity | Fix |
```
